description.en: Chickpeas simmered in a fragrant tomato and spice sauce.
description.ro: Năut fiert într-un sos aromat de roșii și condimente.
description.ar: حمص مطهو في صلصة طماطم وبهارات عطرة.

ingredients: 3 cloves garlic and 1 tbsp grated ginger
Fresh coriander and lemon to serve
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the spices, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they break down.
Stir in the chickpeas with 1/2 cup water and simmer for 12 minutes.
Season, then finish with the coriander and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with rice or flatbread.
